label: miso 122a control
definition: (PROBE — A/B CONTROL, not a keeper) miso-122 arm A: a zero-delta, same-HEAD replay of the MISO keeper 2026-08-03-miso-117b-ct-heat on the PRE-scope-gate chp_power_only_heat_rates_MISO.csv (sha 4cbeb961...). BYTE-IDENTICAL to the keeper (max class-hour |delta| <= 1e-6 in all three years), same determination NOT-YET and the same nine criterion statuses, so it is a valid control for arm B. Exists only to isolate the arm-B delta; the delta between the arms is an INPUT FILE, not a ScenarioConfig key, so the two run_config.json blocks are identical by design.
